caption: 9 hikers. A tent cut open from the inside. Footprints in socks in the snow. The Dyatlov Pass incident has fueled conspiracy theories for 65 years… so what really happened? 👇 #dyatlovpass #mystery #unsolved #conspiracy #history #truecrime #dailydrop

scenes.title: Cut open *from the inside*
scenes.say: February 1959. Nine experienced hikers vanish in Russia's Ural Mountains. When searchers find their tent, it's been cut open. From the inside.

scenes.title: *Footprints in socks*
scenes.say: The Soviet case file describes their footprints in the snow. Some of them walked away barefoot, or in just their socks. On a freezing night.

scenes.text: Bodies found as far as *1.5 km* away
scenes.say: Their bodies were found as far as a kilometer and a half away. Some barely dressed. Others, found months later in a ravine, had severe injuries.

scenes.title: The *theories*:
scenes.say: So the theories exploded. A yeti. U F Os. A secret weapons test. A KGB cover-up.

scenes.title: *No one else*

label.name: "NO TRACES OF A STRUGGLE"
label.role: or of other people · case file, 1959

scenes.say: But the same file says something important. No traces of a struggle. And no sign of anyone else.

scenes.title: The verdict:
scenes.say: In 2020, Russian prosecutors concluded it was an avalanche. In 2021, scientists in Switzerland showed how a small slab of snow could have hit the tent at night, sending them running into the dark. Yetis and aliens? No evidence.
